variable.comment: 1 if only high scores should be submitted, 0 otherwise
variable.name: ArcadeSubmitHighScoreOnly

sub-events.comment: High-score-only mode: submit the gain over the session best, so repeat attempts cannot double-count.
Cumulative mode: submit every attempt as-is.
Game over message. These three read high_score BEFORE it is raised below, so the comparison is against the previous best.
Raise and persist the session high score.

events.comment: Pull the session best in from sessionStorage and from the Arcade config. Takes a max in both directions, so it is idempotent and can never lower the value - order of arrival does not matter.
Mirror high_score into sessionStorage. Wrapped in try/catch because storage can throw in a sandboxed iframe.

Play Again. Resets every run-scoped variable and object, then hands control back to the page state machine by setting page_gameplay last. high_score is deliberately NOT reset - it must survive retries. page_howtoplay stays 0 so the instructions are not shown again.

Bounded poll: Get Game Config is asynchronous, so ArcadeScoreToDisplay may land after start of layout. Re-syncs for ~3s then stops. LoadHighScore is also called at game over, so a slower config is still picked up.
Attempts spent: dim Play Again. The tap handler also checks ArcadeAttemptExhausted, so the button is inert as well as dimmed.
